objective: Assess whether genuine dated conversations contain an earlier, identifiable session with an update, a consequential unchanged suffix, and multiple later questions. The preceding short benchmark gave the cheap notice plus retrieval a ceiling. No cases selected by model results.
development: Use only the first four published users. The first user was inspected during schema exploration. The remaining sixteen users are outside this feasibility audit. No model predictions, answer strings or gold memory point text go into a system prompt.
eligibility: At one later session select official Dynamic Update questions with at least one evidence statement that matches a unique earlier updated memory point by exact text. The later session must be separated by at least one complete intervening session. Report distinct event-to-question-session pairs, counts with a second official question, counts with another question whose evidence belongs exclusively to other sessions, and the intervening dialogue length measured by the pinned 9B tokenizer. Do not assume a second question about a different fact is a paraphrase. Limit this screen to feasibility, with no paper result and no inferred accuracy.
evidence_handling: Source annotations establish eligibility and serve evaluation only. A potential serving model may receive the actual unannotated dated dialogue or updates and must not receive the official memory point or evidence labels. Preserve original files outside the public repository and retain aggregates and record indices locally.
